title: QuantConnect Review 2026: Pricing, Features & Verdict
description: QuantConnect review: Python backtesting, open-source LEAN engine, market data coverage, broker links and pricing details to check before you subscribe.
author: Michael Brooks
excerpt: QuantConnect is a Python backtesting and live trading platform with broad market data, but its plan prices and usage unit are not explained.
content:
QuantConnect is a quantitative research and algorithmic trading platform built around the open-source LEAN engine. It lets users backtest and deploy strategies mostly in Python, with US and global market data and links to several brokers. The site does not list plan prices, so this review focuses on what it offers and what to confirm.

QuantConnect at a Glance

Here is what the source page states and what it leaves out.

CategoryWhat the source says
OperatorQuantConnect brand. No legal entity or address named on the site
LanguagePython. The research notebook uses Python 3.11
EngineLEAN, open source, with a local CLI and cloud backtesting
MarketsUS equities from 1998, equity options, futures, forex, CFDs and crypto from six exchanges
DataPoint-in-time data with fee, slippage and spread modelling; 40+ alternative data vendors
BrokersAbout 20 integrations claimed, including Interactive Brokers, Coinbase, Binance, Kraken and Alpaca
PricingPlans not listed on the page. Usage is charged in a unit called QCC, which the page does not explain

Items come from the reference page and the official site where we checked them. We have not tested the product.

Is QuantConnect Legit? What the Claims Show

Backtesting and optimisation

The platform models fees, slippage, spreads and margin, and it runs parameter sweeps across many full backtests. These are standard features for a quant research platform, and the site presents them clearly.

Platform statistics

The site reports more than 556,000 community members, about 375,000 live deployments since 2012 and over $100 billion in monthly notional volume. These are self-reported figures with no published method.

Speed and AI claims

LEAN Enterprise is said to run up to 40 percent faster, and the site introduces an AI assistant called Mia. Neither claim comes with a benchmark method or pricing on the page.

QuantConnect Costs and Pricing

Plans and prices are not listed on the page, and a usage charge in QCC appears in optimisation runs without an explanation. Read the pricing page and ask what each QCC charge covers before you commit.

Our standard minimum deposit for this review is 250 in the reader's local currency. Software plans do not use a deposit, and the site does not state one, so confirm the subscription cost instead.

Who Is Behind QuantConnect

The site names no legal entity or address and no regulator. It shows three named customer testimonials and press logos labelled as seen on major outlets, but it names no specific articles or awards.

Before You Buy: A Short Checklist

  • Read the pricing page and work out the QCC cost of your own backtests.
  • Check which brokers you need and confirm each integration works for your account type.
  • Test a strategy on the free tier before you pay for live trading.
  • Ask for the legal entity and support hours in writing.

Risks to Keep in Mind

Backtests can look strong and still fail in live trading, especially with optimisation across many parameters. Broker integrations and data licences can add cost and restrictions. The platform does not manage your risk, so position limits remain your responsibility.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is QuantConnect legit?

QuantConnect is an established quant platform with an open-source engine and many users. The site names no legal entity or regulator, so check the company details before you subscribe.

How much does QuantConnect cost?

The site does not list plan prices on the page. It mentions a usage charge in QCC, which is not explained. Read the pricing page first.

Does QuantConnect support Python?

Yes. Python is the language the site shows, and the research notebook uses Python 3.11.

Which brokers does QuantConnect connect to?

The site claims about 20 integrations and shows logos for brokers such as Interactive Brokers, Coinbase, Binance, Kraken and Alpaca. Confirm your own broker before you subscribe.

Does QuantConnect trade for me?

It runs the strategies you write. You still set the logic, the risk limits and the broker account.

Our Verdict on QuantConnect

QuantConnect is a serious research and backtesting platform with a large community and an open-source engine. Its main gaps are the missing plan prices, the unexplained QCC usage unit and the absence of a legal entity on the site. Work out your full cost before you subscribe. Our rating reflects these gaps. We will revisit it once the details above are confirmed.
